A leftover archive of experimental records. Just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to the Life Sciences Institute's Leviathan Essence experiments...

Test Subject: "Humanoid Leviathan Descendant B-H-001"

Subject Origin and Description:
Experimental Subject B-H-001 is the first humanoid leviathan descendant ever captured accidentally in the Calenga Abyss. Its internal essence and DNA sequences show a high degree of consistency with extracts taken from leviathan remains. Height: 19.82 m. Sex: Unconfirmed. Capable of bipedal locomotion and basic communication. Following assessment, the Life Sciences Institute has been authorized to conduct research on its Leviathan Essence and evolutionary mimicry. It has also been designated as Material No. 2189 for the final "Tolerance Test."

Experiment Notes:
(1) B-H-001 displays low compliance and high aggression. Strict restraints must be applied throughout all subsequent experiments.
(2) Standard researchers are strictly prohibited from engaging in any conversation with B-H-001.
(3) B-H-001 is an exceptionally rare specimen. Prior to completing the final "Tolerance Test," minimize damage to vital organs such as the reptilian brain stem and latent gills, and preserve physical integrity to the greatest extent possible.

Experiment 1: Essence Extraction and Activation

Experiment Details: Extract the essence from specimen B-H-001 along the spinal column, then inject it into the bioprocessor.

Experiment Log: Subjects did not quickly convert into flesh masses as anticipated. 57.3% of subjects exhibited heightened neural activity in the brain. After subject death, active cysts were discovered within the cranial cavity.

Conclusion: The essence concentration in the leviathan descendant is far below expected levels, making them viable as stabilizers for leviathan protoplasm injections.

Experiment 2: Abundance's Flesh Inoculation Experiment on Leviathan Descendant

Experiment Details: Joint inoculation of a small dose of inactivated Abundance's flesh alongside other test subjects.

Experiment Log: Compared to other test subjects, B-H-001 showed a significantly accelerated rate of Abundance's flesh corrosion. Just 3 minutes after the experiment began, researchers terminated the experiment and dissected the infected tissue.

Conclusion: The leviathan descendant shows a high degree of affinity with Abundance's flesh, making it an exceptionally promising fusion material and experiment substrate.

...

Experiment ██: Leviathan Remains Protoplasm Tolerance Test

Experiment Details: Subjects are sequentially injected with active Abundance's flesh and leviathan protoplasm carrying active genetic information.

Experiment Log:
12:32:04 — Injection of active Abundance's flesh.
12:32:09 — Injection of leviathan protoplasm.
12:32:13 — B-H-001 exhibiting violent struggling. Neural activity spiking sharply. Effective communication not possible.
12:32:15 — Sedative administered.
12:32:18 — B-H-001 has ceased struggling. Extremities showing signs of flesh-mass formation. Neural activity entering stable high-frequency state.
12:32:20 — B-H-001 experiencing seizures accompanied by incoherent muttering. Effective communication not possible.
12:32:21 — B-H-001 has fully converted into a flesh mass.
......
13:46:27 — B-H-001 flesh mass deceased.

Experiment concluded. Case total output: 3.82 seconds of lucid consciousness.

Conclusion: Output contains no leviathan knowledge. Experiment failed.

B-H-001 has been processed for specimen recovery. Its experimental value is negligible.
The prime experimental subject "Humanoid Leviathan Cluster" has been designated as the new capture target. We need more B-H-001.

Principal Investigator Signature: ███
